name: Fisherman's Wharf at Sunderban Tiger Camp
signature_dish: bengali fish thali with local catch
why_it_matters: On-site restaurant at Sunderban Tiger Camp (Waxpol Hotels' flagship since 2004) on Dayapur Island opposite Sundarbans National Park. Décor uses local fisherman's tools; menu rotates Bengali, Indian, Chinese and Continental. Vegetables, chicken, fish and crab are sourced from the surrounding villages each morning.
insider_tip: Walk-in dining isn't an option — meals are tied to a stay package (1N/2D includes breakfast + 2 lunches + evening snack + dinner). The Mangrove bar adjoins the restaurant and runs a tribal performance most nights at sundown.
signature_address: Sunderban Tiger Camp, Dayapur Island, opposite Sajnekhali, Sundarbans, South 24 Parganas, West Bengal 743370

name: WBTDC Sajnekhali Tourist Lodge Restaurant
why_it_matters: The only government-run lodge inside the Sundarbans Tiger Reserve area, operated by West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation (WBTDC). Menu is essentially Bengali home cooking using fish, prawns and crab caught locally — kitchen calls guests the day before to take dinner orders.
insider_tip: Bookings only via WBTDC channels; walk-in dining isn't allowed. Specify dinner preferences when the lodge calls a day ahead — mutton/chicken needs to be ordered in from the mainland in advance.
signature_address: WBTDC Sajnekhali Tourist Lodge, Sajnekhali, Sundarbans National Park, South 24 Parganas, West Bengal 743370
